Taste and quality of Pho Bo
Sep 2026 • Couples
A nice place with a simple, cozy interior 🙂 We ordered pho bo — liked it, especially the broth: rich and very pleasant in taste. Portions, as is often the case in Vietnam, are huge 😄

They serve a plate of fresh herbs and cold tea separately - it's nice. The prices for pho here are also quite comfortable. Overall a good place to eat delicious and satisfying food 👍

The restaurant is quite pleasant with a simple and cozy atmosphere 🙂 We ordered beef pho and found it quite delicious, especially the broth: rich and very easy to eat. The portions, as is common in Vietnam, are quite large 😄

Pho is served with a separate plate of fresh vegetables and cold tea, a very nice bonus. The price of beef pho here is quite reasonable. Overall, this is a good place to eat delicious and filling food 👍
